title: Hirist Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, locations, remote or onsite, years of experience, skills, pay in lakhs, company rating, posting date and link, and with details on the description and applicants. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: jobs read, matched and saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
